cp.title: PS2 Elite: what every column means
cp.sub: Short answers, one column at a time. Hover any number on the main page for details. Back to the stats · Update log · Formulas: docs/metrics.md
cp.curveAria: Your K/D drawn against opponent strength: high against easy opponents on the left, lower against hard opponents on the right.
cp.idea1: Most ✨ columns read this line: your K/D against opponents from easy (left) to hard (right). It uses the ~200 players you fight most, not your whole career.
cp.idea2: Why it matters: a player can show 3.96 lifetime K/D and only 1.15 against the people he really fights.
cp.whyH: Why Honu and Fisu don’t show these
cp.whyP: They look up one player. These columns also need the stats of your ~200 opponents, so this site keeps them all cached and refreshed. The 📊 Public columns are the same numbers the trackers show.
cp.iviP: How good you are, once your opponents’ strength is counted.
cp.iviL1: Beating strong players counts more than beating weak ones.
cp.iviL2: Fast killing adds a bonus; slow, safe play costs a little.
cp.iviL3: Infantry only: vehicle and MAX kills above 10% lower it (🚜). Confirmed padders lose 10% (💩).
cp.iviHigh: High: you beat strong players at a good pace.
cp.iviLow: Low: your wins come from weak players, or you play slowly. Below zero shows as 0.
cp.actP: Your ☠️ K/D × how fast you kill.
cp.actHigh: High: lots of fights won, quickly.
cp.actLow: Low: you lose more than you win, or you kill slowly.
cp.braveH: 🦁 Brave — does it hold against strong players?
cp.braveP: Your 🏃 Activity, checked against the fastest-killing enemies you meet.
cp.braveHigh: High: you stay strong when the enemy gets strong.
cp.braveLow: Low with a high iVi: you pick easy fights and avoid even ones.
cp.resH: 🛡️ Resist — K/D, weighted by enemy danger
cp.resP: Your ☠️ K/D × how fast your enemies kill. 1.0 K/D against killers is worth more than 1.0 against beginners. ⚔️ iVi is built from it.
cp.resHigh: High: you hold your own against fast killers.
cp.resLow: Low: your K/D comes from slower enemies.
cp.constH: ⚡ Const — do you hold up at the hard end?
cp.constP: Your K/D in the hard third ÷ your K/D in the easy third of the picture above (max 1). Shown as a percentile.
cp.constHigh: High (line stays flat): you do as well against hard opponents as easy ones.
cp.constLow: Low (line drops): you farm easy opponents and struggle against hard ones.
cp.constNote: Catch: someone equally weak everywhere also scores high, so Const is only a colour hint, never a rating.
cp.kdH: ☠️ K/D — against people you actually fight
cp.kdP: Kills ÷ deaths against your ~200 most-fought players. Not your lifetime K/D. Every ✨ column starts from this.
cp.kdHigh: High: you win most of those fights.
cp.kdLow: Low: you die more than you kill.
cp.infP: % of your lifetime kills made with infantry weapons. MAX counts as infantry here; vehicles, turrets and roadkills don’t. Shown from 100 kills (“—” until measured). Hover for your MAX and vehicle shares.
cp.vcP: The first 10% of vehicle kills are free; every % above costs 1% of iVi. MAX kills work the same way, separately. The two add up.
cp.vcNote: Why: farming infantry from a tank, aircraft or MAX is easier than on foot. Hover the iVi value to see the cut. The site owner can exempt a player.
cp.pdP: Players confirmed farming kills on their own or friendly alt accounts get 💩 and lose 10% of iVi (kills on farm accounts are already left out). Hover 💩 for the reason. Think it’s wrong? Contact the site owner.
cp.pubSub: Lifetime numbers from Census, no adjustment. The same ones Honu and Fisu show.
cp.pubKd: Kills ÷ deaths over your whole career, against everyone. Flatters players who farm weak opponents.
cp.pubKpm: Kills per minute over your whole career.
cp.pubOwn: Kills per minute with your own weapons. Drives the iVi pace bonus or cut.
cp.pubAcc: Share of your shots that hit.
cp.pubHsr: Share of your kills that were headshots.
cp.pubIvi: Census’s lifetime infantry score, with no opponent weighting. Compare it with ⚔️ iVi (see the example).
cp.exNameAria: Character name for the example (type any cached name)
cp.dbgP: Older or in-between numbers. Tick “show older debug stats” in the main page footer to see them. Not used to judge anyone.
cp.dbgMech: A guess of your vehicle / mech share, projected from 🛡️ Resist. Not measured.
cp.dbgIvi: ⚔️ iVi before the pace bonus or cut, so slow play still looks good.
cp.dbgEkpm: How fast your opponents kill, on average. Higher = harder opposition.
cp.dbgSlope: The angle of your line. Negative = your K/D drops against harder enemies. Feeds 🦁 Brave.
cp.dbgInfl: Lifetime KD ÷ KD against enemies killing at 0.5+ per minute. Above 1 = easy fights inflate your KD. Lower is better.

tip.zerg: 🪳 How much your results lean on a big group (🎈 Inflation and 🤝 Assists), 0–99. Lower is better.
diff.even: balanced: aim and results roughly agree
diff.hutFrom: 🛖 Reduced from {raw} (rarely dies, slow pace, low accuracy).
diff.missing: Needs ⚔️ iVi (enough fights) and a public IvI
zerg.missing: Needs 🤝 Assists (100 kills in recent Honu sessions) and 🎈 Inflation (enough fights)
pct.morePts: {n} points more {phrase} than the column's lowest ({ref})
cp.diffH: 🔀 Diff — aim on paper vs real results
cp.diffP: Your ⚔️ iVi percentile minus your public IvI (aim) percentile, from −99 to +99. Practice minus theory.
cp.diffImp: 🤥 Impostor (−33 or lower): great aim on paper, but real fights don’t convert it.
cp.diffDh: 😤 DieHard (+33 or higher): you win more than your aim predicts — positioning, fight choice, grit. Vehicle play can push it up too.
cp.diffMid: In between (−32…+32): balanced, aim and results roughly agree.
cp.diffNote: Neither side is better or worse. It shows a play style, not cheating.
cp.diffHut: 🛖 next to a name: rarely dies, slow pace, low accuracy. That player's positive Diff is reduced, because it likely comes from safe positions.
cp.zergP: The lower of two percentiles: 🎈 Inflation (your K/D lifted by easy fights) and 🤝 Assists (kills shared with teammates). 0–99. Shown from 100 kills in recent Honu sessions (“—” until then).
cp.zergHigh: High: easy fights and lots of shared kills, at the same time. Lower is better.
cp.zergLow: Low: you earn your K/D in even fights, or you fight on your own.
cp.zergNote: Why the lower of the two: a solo farmer of easy fights has high Inflation but few assists, and a team player in hard fights has many assists but no inflation. Neither is a zerg, so both stay low.

zrev.note: 🪳 Revives can confirm or lower it.
zrev.explain: 🪳 Revive check: zergs die in crowds, so they get revived a lot. Often revived = Zerg confirmed; rarely revived = Zerg lowered.
flair.inactive: 🪦 Inactive: no activity for over a year (last played {date})
zrev.soft: Revives: rare (more than only {n}% of players), lowered from {raw}.
zrev.plain: Revives: more than {n}% of players, no change.
vdiff.note: Many vehicle kills: a positive Diff counts only in proportion to the kills made on foot.
vdiff.explain: 🔀 Vehicle damp: vehicle kills lift results without aim, so a positive Diff only counts the on-foot part.
diff.vehFrom: 🚜 Reduced from {raw} ({veh}% of kills from vehicles: only the on-foot part counts).
cp.zergRevive: Revive check: where we have Honu XP detail, we also count how many of your deaths got a revive. Zergs die in a crowd, so medics pick them up. Top quarter = Zerg confirmed (hover says so). Bottom half = a high Zerg is softened step by step. Never raised. No XP detail = no change.
cp.diffVeh: Vehicle damp: above the typical vehicle share (about 15% of kills), a positive Diff counts only in proportion to your kills on foot (46% vehicle → ×0.63, 76% → ×0.28). If 🛖 also applies, only the stronger cut counts. Hover the Diff value to see it.
nbd.note: Short play time: a negative Diff is softened (new players are still learning).
nbd.explain: 🐣 New player: a negative 🔀 Diff counts less for players with few hours.
diff.nbdFrom: 🐣 Softened from {raw} (short play time: still learning).
cp.diffNewbie: Newbie softening: a negative Diff is scaled by estimated play time (lifetime kills ÷ lifetime KPM). About 6 h or less (the newest 5% of players) → 0; then it rises smoothly to the full value at about 385 h (the median player). New accounts are still learning, so they are not called 🤥 Impostors yet. Positive Diff is untouched. Hover the Diff value to see it.
